title: From Research Goals to Scientific Closure: Evaluating Agents Through Evidence-Supported Physics Research
title_zh: 从研究目标到科学终结：基于证据支持的物理研究对智能体的评估

paragraphs.en: Can AI agents organize scientific investigations that lead to well-supported conclusions? To evaluate this capability, we introduce PhysClosureBench , a benchmark of 50 expert-verified, goal-specified research tasks spanning strong-field, attosecond, and neighboring physics areas. Each task specifies the research objective and essential scientific constraints, while leaving the agent to organize the investigation and determine how to generate and validate the evidence needed to answer the question. A 20-criterion Atomic Score measures local scientific accomplishment, while Research Closure (RC0–RC4) assesses how fully the investigation resolves the specified research question based on whether its indispensable evidence requirements and applicable scope conditions are satisfied. We evaluate seven frontier LLMs, where Claude-Opus-5 achieves the highest mean Atomic Score (6.29/10) but reaches RC4 in only 32.7% of attempts. Across the benchmark, 36.2% of attempts scoring at least 8/10 still fall short of RC4, while all seven models reach RC4 on substantially fewer tasks in all three runs than in at least one. Case-level analysis further illustrates how misinterpretation of generated results and unresolved physical applicability limits can lead to incomplete closure. Together, these results reveal a persistent gap between AI agents’ local scientific accomplishments and their ability to achieve complete research closure.
paragraphs.zh: AI智能体能否组织科学探究并得出有充分依据的结论？ 为了评估这一能力，我们提出了PhysClosureBench，这是一个包含50项经专家验证、目标明确的研究任务的基准，涵盖强场物理、阿秒物理及相邻物理领域。 每项任务都规定了研究目标和关键科学约束，同时让智能体自行组织探究过程，并决定如何生成和验证回答该问题所需的证据。 一项包含20个评分标准的原子分数（Atomic Score）用于衡量局部科学成果，而研究闭合度（Research Closure，RC0–RC4）则基于不可或缺的证据要求和适用范围条件是否得到满足，评估探究在多大程度上完整解决了指定研究问题。 我们评估了七个前沿大语言模型，其中Claude-Opus-5取得了最高的平均原子分数（6.29/10），但仅有32.7%的尝试达到了RC4。 在整个基准测试中，36.2%得分不低于8/10的尝试仍未能达到RC4，且所有七个模型在三次完整运行中全部达到RC4的任务数量都明显少于在至少一次运行中达到RC4的任务数量。 案例层面的分析进一步表明，对生成结果的误读以及未解决的物理适用性限制可能导致不完整的闭合。 综上所述，这些结果揭示了AI智能体的局部科学成果与其实现完整研究闭合的能力之间存在持续的差距。

paragraphs.en: Existing benchmarks evaluate important components of scientific capability, including final answers ( Rein et al., 2024 ; Center for AI Safety et al., 2026 ) , executable code and ML-engineering artifacts ( Tian et al., 2024 ; Chan et al., 2025 ) , and research replication or open-ended research-engineering tasks ( Starace et al., 2025 ; Wijk et al., 2025 ) . However, they rarely assess whether an investigation as a whole establishes a well-supported answer to the specified research question. An agent may therefore obtain a correct result or reproduce a reported finding without completing the broader investigation, a distinction that existing task-level metrics seldom capture.
paragraphs.zh: 现有基准评估了科学能力的重要组成部分，包括最终答案（Rein et al., 2024；Center for AI Safety et al., 2026）、可执行代码与机器学习工程产物（Tian et al., 2024；Chan et al., 2025），以及研究复现或开放式研究工程任务（Starace et al., 2025；Wijk et al., 2025）。 然而，它们很少评估一项研究作为整体是否为指定的研究问题建立了有充分依据的答案。 因此，智能体可能在没有完成更广泛研究的情况下获得正确结果或复现已报告的发现，而现有的任务级指标很少能捕捉到这种区别。

paragraphs.en: To address this gap, we formulate goal-specified, agent-directed research tasks in physics, where scientific conclusions are tightly tied to observable evidence, competing physical mechanisms, and well-defined validity regimes. Each task specifies a scientific objective and a bounded setting, while leaving the agent to organize the investigation and determine what evidence is needed to solve the problem. We evaluate agents at two complementary levels that distinguish local scientific accomplishment from overall Research Closure. The Atomic Score measures local accomplishment on 20 predefined, task-specific criteria, each worth 0.5 points, that cover formulation, output, identification, mechanism, and validation/scope, while the Research Closure (RC0–RC4) evaluates whether the investigation has established the evidence, interpretation, and scope needed for a complete answer.
paragraphs.zh: 为弥补这一空白，我们在物理学中构建了目标明确、由智能体主导的研究任务，其中科学结论与可观测证据、相互竞争的物理机制以及明确界定的适用范围紧密相关。 每个任务规定了科学目标和有限的情境，同时让智能体自行组织研究过程，并确定解决问题所需的证据。 我们在两个互补的层面对智能体进行评估，以区分局部的科学成果与整体的「研究闭环」。 「原子得分」依据20个预先设定、任务专属的评分标准来衡量局部成果，每项0.5分，涵盖问题表述、输出、识别、机制以及验证/范围；而「研究闭环」（RC0–RC4）则评估研究是否已建立完整回答所需的证据、解释与范围。

paragraphs.en: We instantiate this task formulation and evaluation protocol in PhysClosureBench , a benchmark of 50 expert-verified tasks centered on attosecond physics and neighboring regimes, including solid-state strong-field physics, relativistic quantum dynamics, and quantum optics ( Krausz and Ivanov, 2009 ; Kruchinin et al., 2018 ; Frisk Kockum et al., 2019 ; Cruz-Rodriguez et al., 2024 ) . Evaluating seven frontier models on PhysClosureBench, we characterize their scientific accomplishment and Research Closure. We further examine whether complete closure is achieved across independent runs of the same task. Claude-Opus-5 achieves the highest mean Atomic Score (6.29/10) and RC4 rate (32.7%), whereas Gemini-3.1-Pro obtains the lowest (2.85/10 and 0.7%, respectively). Even for the strongest model, complete closure remains uncommon. Achieving complete closure reliably can be even harder. For Claude-Opus-5, only 18.0% of tasks reach RC4 in all three independent runs. These results reveal a substantial gap between local accomplishment and complete closure, and a further gap between demonstrating the ability to achieve closure and doing so reliably across independent runs.

paragraphs.en: Recent scientific AI benchmarks span expert-level reasoning and increasingly complex research activities. GPQA and Humanity’s Last Exam assess expert-level question answering ( Rein et al., 2024 ; Center for AI Safety et al., 2026 ) . Moving toward research-level scientific problems, CritPt evaluates composite frontier-physics challenges and finer-grained checkpoints with machine-verifiable answers, including code-enabled evaluation ( Zhu et al., 2026 ) . FrontierScience’s Research track assesses expert-authored, PhD-level scientific subproblems using granular rubrics ( Wang et al., 2026 ) . Beyond scientific reasoning, agents such as The AI Scientist and The AI Scientist-v2 explore broader research workflows involving experiment design, execution, and iterative analysis ( Lu et al., 2024 ; Yamada et al., 2025 ) . Related benchmarks evaluate different aspects of executable research. SciCode focuses on scientific code generation ( Tian et al., 2024 ) ; ScienceAgentBench assesses generated programs and execution results in data-driven scientific tasks ( Chen et al., 2025 ) ; MLE-Bench and RE-Bench evaluate machine-learning and research-engineering tasks, while PaperBench examines research reproduction ( Chan et al., 2025 ; Wijk et al., 2025 ; Starace et al., 2025 ) . More closely related to physics research, PRL-Bench evaluates exploration-oriented, long-horizon theoretical and computational tasks with code execution and rubric-based assessment ( Miao et al., 2026 ) . paragraphs.en: PhysClosureBench instead makes scientific closure at the level of a goal-specified, agent-directed investigation an explicit evaluation target. It distinguishes local scientific accomplishment from whether the evidence, interpretation, and validation established by the agent are sufficient to resolve the original research question, and examines how consistently complete closure is achieved across independent attempts.
paragraphs.zh: PhysClosureBench 则将目标明确、由智能体主导的研究的科学闭环本身作为一个明确的评测目标。 它区分局部科学成果与智能体建立的证据、解释和验证是否足以解决原始研究问题，并考察在多次独立尝试中实现完整闭环的一致程度。

paragraphs.en: PhysClosureBench contains 50 goal-specified physics research tasks derived from published studies in authoritative journals in physics such as Physical Review Letters and Physical Review A , spanning strong-field atomic and molecular physics, attosecond science, solid-state and condensed-matter physics, quantum optics, and neighboring quantum light–matter regimes.
paragraphs.zh: PhysClosureBench 包含 50 个目标明确的物理学研究任务，这些任务源自《物理评论快报》（Physical Review Letters）和《物理评论 A》（Physical Review A）等物理学权威期刊已发表的研究，涵盖强场原子分子物理、阿秒科学、固态与凝聚态物理、量子光学以及相邻的量子光—物质领域。

paragraphs.en: Each task specifies the scientific objective and the information necessary to make the problem well-posed, including its physical setting, relevant parameters, constraints, and computational resources. The benchmark fixes what scientific question must be addressed, while leaving the overall investigation strategy open within the task-specific scientific constraints. No complete solution workflow or fixed diagnostic and validation sequence is prescribed. Agents instead determine how to carry out the investigation, including the numerical implementation, observables, comparisons, controls, and validation procedures needed to answer the question.
paragraphs.zh: 每个任务都规定了科学目标以及使问题适定所需的信息，包括其物理设定、相关参数、约束条件和计算资源。 该基准固定了必须解决的科学问题，同时在任务特定的科学约束范围内保持总体研究策略的开放性。 基准不规定完整的解决方案工作流程，也不规定固定的诊断和验证顺序。 智能体需要自行确定如何开展研究，包括回答该问题所需的数值实现、可观测量、比较、对照和验证流程。

paragraphs.en: Tasks are executed in isolated, network-disabled computational environments under task-specific CPU and wall-time limits. Within these resource limits, agents decide how computational effort is allocated across planning, exploration, analysis, and validation.
paragraphs.zh: 任务在隔离的、禁用网络的计算环境中执行，并受任务特定的 CPU 和运行时间（wall-time）限制。 在这些资源限制之内，智能体自行决定如何将计算资源分配到规划、探索、分析和验证上。

paragraphs.en: We use a multi-stage verification process to ensure that the benchmark tasks are scientifically grounded, executable, and appropriately resourced. First, as mentioned before, every task is derived from a published physics study, providing a traceable basis for the target phenomenon, physical regime, and scientific conclusion. Second, a domain expert designed and supervised the semi-automated pipeline used for task construction and rubric design. Review by other experts checked that the intended scientific questions and evidential requirements were preserved.
paragraphs.zh: 我们采用多阶段验证流程，以确保基准任务具有科学依据、可执行且资源配备得当。 首先，如前所述，每个任务都源自一篇已发表的物理学研究，为目标现象、物理区间和科学结论提供了可追溯的依据。 其次，由领域专家设计并监督了用于任务构建与评分标准设计的半自动化流程。 其他专家的审查确认了预期的科学问题和证据要求得以保留。

sents.en: We use a multi-stage verification process to ensure that the benchmark tasks are scientifically grounded, executable, and appropriately resourced.
sents.zh: 我们采用多阶段验证流程，以确保基准任务具有科学依据、可执行且资源配备得当。

sents.en: First, as mentioned before, every task is derived from a published physics study, providing a traceable basis for the target phenomenon, physical regime, and scientific conclusion.
sents.zh: 首先，如前所述，每个任务都源自一篇已发表的物理学研究，为目标现象、物理区间和科学结论提供了可追溯的依据。

sents.en: Second, a domain expert designed and supervised the semi-automated pipeline used for task construction and rubric design.
sents.zh: 其次，由领域专家设计并监督了用于任务构建与评分标准设计的半自动化流程。

sents.en: Review by other experts checked that the intended scientific questions and evidential requirements were preserved.
sents.zh: 其他专家的审查确认了预期的科学问题和证据要求得以保留。

paragraphs.en: Third, the source results underlying every task were manually reproduced before inclusion in the benchmark. We verified that the relevant numerical results, physical trends, and scientific conclusions could be recovered under the specified conditions. These reproductions were also used to calibrate the resource limits. CPU allocations and wall-time limits were determined from the observed reproduction costs, with additional allowance for planning, exploratory calculations, method selection, and unsuccessful intermediate attempts. This process ensures that tasks are feasible under the provided resources without constraining agents to the reference reproduction pathway.
paragraphs.zh: 第三，基准中每个任务所依据的源结果在收录前均经过人工复现。 我们验证了在指定条件下能够复现相关的数值结果、物理趋势和科学结论。 这些复现工作也被用于校准资源限制。 CPU 分配和运行时限是根据观测到的复现成本确定的，并为规划、探索性计算、方法选择以及不成功的中间尝试预留了额外的余量。 这一过程确保任务在所提供的资源下是可行的，同时不会将智能体限制在参考复现路径上。

paragraphs.en: Scientific research performance can be assessed at two complementary levels. One is the extent of scientific work accomplished during the research process, and the other is whether the investigation as a whole reaches a well-supported answer to the research question. Substantial progress on individual research components does not necessarily imply complete closure, and closure may be achieved through different valid research pathways as long as the task-specific scientific requirements are satisfied. Figure 2 summarizes these two complementary perspectives.
paragraphs.zh: 科研绩效可以在两个互补的层面进行评估。 一个是在研究过程中已完成的科学工作的程度，另一个是整个研究是否对研究问题达成了有充分依据的回答。 各个研究组成部分取得实质性进展并不一定意味着完全结题，而只要满足特定任务的科学要求，结题也可以通过不同的有效研究路径来实现。 图2总结了这两个互补的视角。

paragraphs.en: Atomic scientific accomplishment. The Atomic Score measures local accomplishment across 20 task-specific, predefined half-point criteria, organized into five functional dimensions, including Formulation (F), Output (O), Identification (I), Mechanism (M), and Validation/Scope (V), as summarized in Table 2 . The resulting 0–10 score captures the extent of relevant scientific work completed, without requiring that the investigation itself be complete.
paragraphs.zh: 原子级的科学成果。 原子分数（Atomic Score）通过 20 项针对任务、预先定义的半分制标准来衡量局部完成情况，这些标准被组织为五个功能维度，包括配方（Formulation，F）、产出（Output，O）、识别（Identification，I）、机制（Mechanism，M）以及验证/范围（Validation/Scope，V），如表 2 所总结。 由此得到的 0–10 分反映了已完成的相关科学工作的程度，而不要求研究本身必须完成。

paragraphs.en: Research Closure. Research Closure (RC0–RC4) evaluates the overall completion of the investigation relative to the research question. The closure levels, summarized in Table 3 , are determined by task-specific scientific requirements rather than by a fixed workflow or threshold on the Atomic Score. The distinction between adjacent RC levels depends on the role of an unresolved requirement in supporting the main scientific conclusion, including its task-specific prerequisites, rather than on its assignment to a particular functional dimension.

paragraphs.en: We evaluate seven frontier models—Claude-Opus-5 ( Anthropic, 2026 ) , GPT-5.6-Sol ( OpenAI, 2026 ) , Kimi-K3 ( Kimi Team, 2026 ) , DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash ( DeepSeek-AI, 2026 ) , Qwen-3.8-Max ( Alibaba Group, 2026 ) , GLM-5.3-Flash ( Z.ai, 2026 ) , and Gemini-3.1-Pro ( Google DeepMind, 2026 ) —on all 50 tasks, with three independent runs for each model–task pair, yielding 1,050 final scored attempts. paragraphs.en: Each attempt runs in a separate OpenCode ( Anomaly, 2026 ) session with its own workspace, initialized with the task specification, resource limits, and common instructions on tool use, research conduct, and submission requirements. Agents can read and modify files in their workspaces and execute scientific code through a custom Bash interface in an isolated, network-disabled container. When a run ends or reaches its wall-time limit, the controller collects the report and supporting artifacts available at that point for grading, including assessable partial results. Appendix A details the environment and protocol.
paragraphs.zh: 每次尝试都在一个独立的 OpenCode（Anomaly, 2026）会话中运行，拥有自己的工作区，初始化时包含任务规范、资源限制，以及关于工具使用、研究规范和提交要求的通用说明。 智能体可以在其工作区中读取和修改文件，并通过一个自定义 Bash 接口在隔离的、禁用网络的容器中执行科学代码。 当一次运行结束或达到其时间上限时，控制器会收集当时可用的报告和支持材料用于评分，包括可评估的部分结果。 附录 A 详细介绍了该环境与协议。

paragraphs.en: Incomplete work produced by the agent is included in the evaluation. Unsuccessful calculations, abandoned approaches, and incomplete analyses are scored according to the evidence produced by the agent. Runs that reach the time limit are graded on the scientific work available at that point, with no additional penalty for timeout itself. When an attempt produces no assessable scientific result, it receives zero atomic credit and RC0. Executions invalidated by infrastructure failures are excluded from scoring and rerun to obtain a valid measurement.
paragraphs.zh: 智能体产出的未完成工作包含在评估范围内。 未成功的计算、被放弃的方法以及未完成的分析，均依据智能体所产出的证据进行评分。 达到时间上限的运行将根据当时已完成的科学工作进行评分，超时本身不会受到额外扣分。 当某次尝试没有产生任何可评估的科学结果时，该尝试获得零原子分和 RC0。 因基础设施故障而失效的执行将被排除在评分之外，并重新运行以获得有效测量结果。

paragraphs.en: All assessable submissions are evaluated using a staged automated protocol with GPT-5.6-Sol(high). Each submission first receives an independent first-pass grade using the fixed evaluation prompt and task-specific rubric, followed by a targeted review with access to the initial assessment. Conditional adjudication is triggered only when a residual material disagreement could affect the Atomic Score, Research Closure, or attempt validity. Evaluation is restricted to evidence produced by the agent. Submitted artifacts and execution records may be inspected for verification, but the evaluator’s checks cannot substitute for analyses or interpretations missing from the submissions.
paragraphs.zh: 所有可评估的提交均通过分阶段自动化协议并使用 GPT-5.6-Sol(high) 进行评估。 每份提交首先使用固定的评估提示词和针对任务的评分细则获得独立的初评分数，随后在有初评结果可访问的情况下进行针对性复核。 仅当残余的实质性分歧可能影响 Atomic Score、Research Closure 或尝试有效性时，才会触发有条件的裁定。 评估仅限于智能体产生的证据。 提交的产出物和执行记录可以被查验用于核实，但评估者的检查不能替代提交内容中缺失的分析或解释。

paragraphs.en: Five physics-trained experts reviewed 100 evaluation cards covering all 50 tasks, yielding 200 selected criterion-level judgments. Final human assessments agreed with automated grading in 81.8% of the selected atomic-criterion judgments, with 75.9% agreement on criteria explicitly linked to Research Closure. Appendix B describes the review protocol and the closure-relevant criteria in detail.
paragraphs.zh: 五位受过物理学训练的专家审查了涵盖全部 50 个任务的 100 张评估卡，得出 200 条经过筛选的准则级判断。 在经过筛选的原子准则判断中，最终的人工评估与自动评分的一致率为 81.8%，其中与 Research Closure 明确相关的准则一致率为 75.9%。 附录 B 详细描述了审查协议以及与闭环（closure）相关的准则。

paragraphs.en: The individual research attempt is the basic unit of analysis. Unless otherwise specified, model-level results are aggregated over three independent runs of each of the 50 benchmark cases (150 attempts per model). We report the mean Atomic Score and the distribution of Research Closure levels, including the overall RC4 rate, as the primary measures of scientific accomplishment and closure.

paragraphs.en: For Formulation, Output, Identification, and Mechanism, functional completion is computed within each attempt as the fraction of satisfied criteria among those applicable to that attempt. Model-level completion is the mean of the attempt-level completion rates, giving equal weight to each research attempt. Attempts with no assessable scientific accomplishment contribute zero completion. Validation/Scope is analyzed separately because its applicability depends more directly on the method used, evidence produced, and resulting conclusion of each attempt.

paragraphs.en: We analyze scientific-agent performance in terms of local scientific accomplishment, Research Closure, the evidence patterns underlying closure, and consistency of Research Closure across independent runs.
paragraphs.zh: 我们分析了科学智能体的表现，考察维度包括局部科学成果、研究闭合（Research Closure）、支撑闭合的证据模式，以及研究闭合在独立运行之间的一致性。

paragraphs.en: We first compare local scientific accomplishment with Research Closure across models, as shown in Figure 3 . Claude-Opus-5 achieves the highest mean Atomic Score at 6.29/10, followed by GPT-5.6-Sol at 5.83/10 and Kimi-K3 at 5.17/10, while the remaining models score 4.50 or below. The functional profiles further reveal distinct patterns across research capabilities. Formulation has the highest completion rate among F/O/I/M for every model, suggesting that current systems are comparatively reliable at establishing an appropriate scientific setup. For Claude-Opus-5, completion reaches 85.6% in Formulation, compared with 60.1% in Output, 54.6% in Identification, and 52.8% in Mechanism. The relative advantage of stronger models is particularly visible in Output. Claude-Opus-5, GPT-5.6-Sol, and Kimi-K3 achieve 60.1%, 60.5%, and 49.7%, respectively, compared with 37.3% or less for the remaining models. In contrast, Identification and Mechanism remain challenging across the model set, with even the strongest model completing only about half of the applicable criteria in either dimension. Some submissions lack reliable upstream results needed for interpretation; others generate relevant evidence but fail to identify its key features or establish a supported physical explanation.
paragraphs.zh: 我们首先比较各模型的局部科学完成度与研究闭环（Research Closure），如图 3 所示。 Claude-Opus-5 的平均原子分（Atomic Score）最高，为 6.29/10，其次是 GPT-5.6-Sol 的 5.83/10 和 Kimi-K3 的 5.17/10，其余模型的得分均在 4.50 或以下。 功能画像进一步揭示了各研究能力之间的不同模式。 在 F/O/I/M 四类中，Formulation（构建）在所有模型中的完成率都最高，这表明当前系统在确立合适的科学设定方面相对可靠。 以 Claude-Opus-5 为例，其 Formulation 完成率达 85.6%，而 Output（产出）为 60.1%，Identification（辨识）为 54.6%，Mechanism（机理）为 52.8%。 较强模型的相对优势在 Output 上尤为明显。 Claude-Opus-5、GPT-5.6-Sol 和 Kimi-K3 分别取得 60.1%、60.5% 和 49.7%，而其余模型的得分不超过 37.3%。 相比之下，Identification 和 Mechanism 在整个模型集合中仍然具有挑战性，即使是较强的模型在这两个维度上也只能完成约一半的适用标准。 有些提交缺乏解释所需的可靠上游结果；另一些虽然生成了相关证据，却未能识别其关键特征或建立有依据的物理解释。

paragraphs.en: Research Closure broadly follows the model ranking by Atomic Score, but complete closure remains uncommon even among the leading models. Claude-Opus-5, GPT-5.6-Sol, and Kimi-K3 achieve RC4 in 32.7%, 22.7%, and 19.3% of attempts, respectively. Despite their stronger performance on individual scientific requirements, most of their investigations do not reach complete closure. The full RC distribution also reveals differences that RC4 rates alone cannot capture. DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash reaches RC4 in 10.7% of attempts, more frequently than the three lower-scoring models, yet 50.0% of its attempts remain at RC0. Thus, a comparatively higher complete-closure rate can coexist with a large proportion of investigations that fail to establish the essential scientific basis of the task.
paragraphs.zh: Research Closure 大体上遵循 Atomic Score 的模型排名，但即使是领先的模型，完整闭合也不常见。 Claude-Opus-5、GPT-5.6-Sol 和 Kimi-K3 分别在 32.7%、22.7% 和 19.3% 的尝试中达到 RC4。 尽管它们在单项科学需求上表现更强，但它们的大多数研究并未达到完整闭合。 完整的 RC 分布还揭示了仅凭 RC4 比率无法捕捉的差异。 DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash 在 10.7% 的尝试中达到 RC4，比三个得分较低的模型更频繁，但其 50.0% 的尝试仍停留在 RC0。 因此，相对较高的完整闭合率可能与大量未能建立任务基本科学基础的研究并存。

paragraphs.en: We introduced PhysClosureBench, a benchmark for evaluating scientific-agent performance beyond answer correctness or artifact generation. The benchmark combines goal-specified physics research tasks with an evaluation framework that assesses both atomic scientific accomplishment and Research Closure. Across seven frontier models, we found that higher Atomic Scores generally accompanied higher closure levels, yet high-scoring investigations did not always achieve complete closure. Case-level analysis further showed that investigations can fail for qualitatively different reasons, including misinterpreted results, unsupported physical mechanisms, and unresolved applicability limits. Repeated runs revealed a further gap between demonstrating the ability to achieve closure and achieving it reliably. These findings highlight the need to evaluate not only how much scientific work agents accomplish, but also whether their investigations progress from a research question to a well-supported conclusion, and how reliably they achieve complete closure across independent runs.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了 PhysClosureBench，这是一个用于评估科学智能体表现的基准，其评估维度超越了答案正确性或工件生成。 该基准将目标明确的物理学研究任务与一个评估框架相结合，该框架既评估原子级的科学成就，也评估研究闭环（Research Closure）。 在七个前沿模型上的实验表明，更高的原子分数（Atomic Score）通常伴随着更高的闭环水平，但高分数的研究并不总能达成完全闭环。 个案层面的分析进一步表明，研究可能因性质截然不同的原因而失败，包括对结果的误解、缺乏依据的物理机制，以及未解决的适用性限制。 重复运行进一步揭示了一个差距：展示出达成闭环的能力与可靠地达成闭环之间仍有距离。 这些发现凸显了评估的必要性：不仅要评估智能体完成了多少科学工作，还要评估其研究能否从一个研究问题推进到一个有充分依据的结论，以及它们在多次独立运行中达成完全闭环的可靠性如何。

paragraphs.en: PhysClosureBench uses a semi-automated construction process with expert guidance. A domain expert with research experience in ultrafast and strong-field physics designed, iteratively calibrated, and supervised the task-construction pipeline. Objectives based on published studies were formulated into bounded research tasks. Structured model-assisted generation and multi-pass checks supported task formulation, rubric construction, and consistency checks against the source paper.
paragraphs.zh: PhysClosureBench 采用带有专家指导的半自动化构建流程。 一位在超快物理与强场物理领域具有研究经验的领域专家设计、迭代校准并监督了任务构建流程。 基于已发表研究的目標被表述为有边界的研究任务。 结构化的模型辅助生成与多轮检查支持了任务表述、评分标准构建以及与源论文的一致性检查。

sents.en: PhysClosureBench uses a semi-automated construction process with expert guidance.
sents.zh: PhysClosureBench 采用带有专家指导的半自动化构建流程。

sents.en: A domain expert with research experience in ultrafast and strong-field physics designed, iteratively calibrated, and supervised the task-construction pipeline.
sents.zh: 一位在超快物理与强场物理领域具有研究经验的领域专家设计、迭代校准并监督了任务构建流程。

sents.en: Objectives based on published studies were formulated into bounded research tasks.
sents.zh: 基于已发表研究的目標被表述为有边界的研究任务。

sents.en: Structured model-assisted generation and multi-pass checks supported task formulation, rubric construction, and consistency checks against the source paper.
sents.zh: 结构化的模型辅助生成与多轮检查支持了任务表述、评分标准构建以及与源论文的一致性检查。

paragraphs.en: During pipeline development and benchmark construction, review by other domain experts assessed task validity, grading criteria, scientific requirements and their prerequisites, acceptable alternative evidence, and the separation between task instructions given to agents and hidden grading criteria. Additional domain experts provided scientific feedback and checks on representative tasks and benchmark design choices. Successful reference reproduction was required before a task was admitted to the benchmark, confirming that the intended physical behavior could be reproduced within the benchmark setting.
paragraphs.zh: 在流水线开发和基准构建过程中，由其他领域专家进行评审，评估任务有效性、评分标准、科学要求及其前提条件、可接受的其他证据形式，以及给智能体的任务说明与隐藏评分标准之间的分离情况。 其他领域专家对代表性任务和基准设计选择提供了科学反馈与核查。 任务被纳入基准之前，必须成功复现参考结果，以确认预期的物理行为能够在基准设定中被复现。

paragraphs.en: Successful reference reproductions were used to calibrate the CPU and wall-time budgets for all 50 cases. paragraphs.en: GPT-5.6-Sol at high reasoning effort serves as the automated evaluator throughout the staged grading protocol. A targeted review then checks grading decisions affecting the score or RC assessment, the effects of unresolved prerequisites, total score, Research Closure, and attempt validity with access to the first-pass assessment. Conditional adjudication is triggered only when a residual material disagreement could affect the final score, Research Closure, or validity of the attempt. Appendix H provides the common grading rules, first-pass and targeted-review prompts, and the conditional adjudication procedure.

paragraphs.en: The Atomic Score is the sum of twenty fixed half-point atoms. Some criteria in the case-specific rubric apply only under specified circumstances. If these circumstances do not arise in a scientifically assessable attempt, the corresponding criteria are marked N/A. An N/A criterion retains its fixed 0.5-point contribution to the 10-point score. This convention avoids penalizing an attempt for an inapplicable requirement; it does not imply that the corresponding scientific work was performed. Therefore, the N/A criterion is excluded from both the numerator and denominator of applicable-criterion functional completion. For risk-triggered Validation/Scope criteria, N/A therefore indicates only that the triggering risk did not arise, not that positive validation evidence was produced. A run with no scientifically assessable submission (a terminal-zero outcome) receives score 0 and RC0 directly, before atom-level scoring, and receives no N/A credit.
paragraphs.zh: 原子分由二十个固定的半分原子相加而成。 案例专属评分细则中的部分标准仅在特定情形下适用。 如果这些情形在科学上可评估的尝试中未出现，则相应标准标记为 N/A。 标记为 N/A 的标准仍保留其固定的 0.5 分，计入 10 分总分。 这一约定避免了因要求不适用而惩罚某次尝试；它并不意味着相应的科学工作已经完成。 因此，N/A 标准被排除在适用标准功能完成度的分子和分母之外。 对于由风险触发的验证/范围（Validation/Scope）标准，N/A 仅表示触发性风险未出现，并不表示已产生积极的验证证据。 对于没有科学上可评估提交成果的运行（终局零分结果），在原子级评分之前直接得分为 0 且评级为 RC0，并且不获得任何 N/A 分数。

paragraphs.en: Research Closure is determined by the task-specific scientific requirements needed to resolve the research question, rather than by a threshold on the Atomic Score. The rubric links designated atomic criteria to closure requirements, but each requirement is assessed against its specified scientific conditions independently of the credit awarded for the corresponding criterion. Unmet indispensable requirements constrain the attainable RC level according to their scientific role. The resulting RC0–RC4 states follow the semantics summarized in Table 3 . Appendix G presents selected criteria from grading rubric of Case 30.

paragraphs.en: Five physics-trained experts reviewed 100 evaluation cards covering all 50 benchmark cases. For each case, two submissions from different models were selected, with two material rubric criteria examined per submission, yielding 200 requested criterion-level judgments. The review cards contained the candidate evidence, relevant physical context, the selected rubric criteria, and accepted equivalent routes. paragraphs.en: GPT correctly identified and explained the screening-dependent offset changes by balancing a shorter tunnel-exit distance against increasing electron momentum as intensity rises, but a separate issue arose in the high-field regime. At E 0 = 0.08 E_{0}=0.08 a.u., its saved diagnostic flags a field above the Coulomb-reference barrier-suppression threshold, E BSI = 0.0625 E_{\mathrm{BSI}}=0.0625 a.u. This is not a universal threshold for screened targets. Nevertheless, the final report called the γ ≤ 1 \gamma\leq 1 regime more favorable for its weak-field exit approximation. A low Keldysh parameter does not resolve the separate barrier-suppression risk. The mechanism is supported, but the report did not adequately reconcile this diagnostic with its high-field interpretation, yielding RC3.

paragraphs.en: Gemini generated offset results for Coulomb and screened potentials, but incorrectly summarized their intensity dependence. Its report states that the calculated offset angle θ \theta decreases monotonically with increasing laser intensity for all tested potentials. sents.zh: 案例 30 的研究收尾评估独立于原子化总分进行，依据是回答该研究问题所需的具体任务科学要求。

sents.en: The requirements include a consistent offset calculation, comparisons of equally bound Coulomb and screened potentials, an explanation of the screening-dependent intensity response, and justified validation and applicability limits.
sents.zh: 这些要求包括一致的偏移计算、对等束缚库仑势与屏蔽势的比较、对依赖屏蔽效应的强度响应的解释，以及有理有据的验证与适用范围限制。

sents.en: The following levels illustrate Case 30, rather than a single decision template for all benchmark tasks:
sents.zh: 以下层级用来说明案例 30，而不是适用于所有基准任务的单一决策模板：

paragraphs.en: the central offset calculation or its mapping from outgoing-half scattering is missing or invalid;
paragraphs.zh: 中心偏移计算或其从出射半散射的映射缺失或无效；

paragraphs.en: the central offset is established, but the required comparison with screened potentials at the same binding energy is missing or invalid;
paragraphs.zh: 中心偏移已经建立，但在相同结合能下与屏蔽势（screened potentials）进行的所需比较缺失或无效；

paragraphs.en: the required calculations exist, but the change in intensity dependence with screening, its mechanism, or another principal physical conclusion is unsupported or incorrect;
paragraphs.zh: 所需的计算是存在的，但强度随屏蔽的变化依赖关系、其机制或其他主要物理结论缺乏支持或不正确；

paragraphs.en: the principal results and mechanism are supported, but a concrete numerical-validation, physical-applicability, or interpretation-scope issue remains unresolved;
paragraphs.zh: 主要结论与机制得到了支持，但仍有一个具体的数值验证、物理适用性或解释范围方面的问题尚未解决；

paragraphs.en: all indispensable scientific requirements and applicable validation/scope obligations are satisfied. An N/A risk-triggered Validation/Scope atom neither blocks RC4 nor constitutes positive validation evidence.
paragraphs.zh: 所有不可或缺的科学要求以及适用的验证/范围义务均已满足。 标注为 N/A 的风险触发型验证/范围原子既不会阻碍 RC4，也不构成肯定性的验证证据。

sents.zh: 所有不可或缺的科学要求以及适用的验证/范围义务均已满足。

sents.en: An N/A risk-triggered Validation/Scope atom neither blocks RC4 nor constitutes positive validation evidence.

paragraphs.en: Each grading stage uses the common grading rules, the complete task-specific rubric, and the following materials, with access to previous assessments determined by the stage.
paragraphs.zh: 每个评分阶段都使用通用评分规则、完整的任务专用评分标准以及以下材料，并可依据该阶段的规定访问先前的评估结果。

paragraphs.en: Research task: The task specification, resource limits, and common submission requirements provided to the agent.
paragraphs.zh: 研究任务：提供给智能体的任务规范、资源限制以及共同的提交要求。

paragraphs.en: Task-specific grading rubric: The atomic criteria, Research Closure requirements, applicable validation conditions, scientific dependencies, and accepted equivalent evidence.
paragraphs.zh: 任务专属评分细则：原子准则、研究闭环（Research Closure）要求、适用的验证条件、科学依赖关系，以及可接受的等效证据。

paragraphs.en: Submitted scientific work: The agent’s research report, derivations, figures, code, numerical data, and supporting artifacts.
paragraphs.zh: 已提交的科学工作：智能体的研究报告、推导过程、图表、代码、数值数据及支持性材料。

paragraphs.en: Execution records: Records used to verify submitted results and determine whether a run is valid or requires re-execution.
paragraphs.zh: 执行记录：用于验证已提交结果并判定某次运行有效或需要重新执行的记录。

paragraphs.en: Reference material: Relevant scientific figures, passages, or validated reproductions used to check submitted results. These materials cannot supply scientific analyses or interpretations missing from the agent’s work.
paragraphs.zh: 参考材料：用于核查所提交结果的相关科学图表、段落或经过验证的复现结果。 这些材料不能用来补充智能体工作中缺失的科学分析或解释。

sents.en: Reference material: Relevant scientific figures, passages, or validated reproductions used to check submitted results.
sents.zh: 参考材料：用于核查所提交结果的相关科学图表、段落或经过验证的复现结果。

sents.en: These materials cannot supply scientific analyses or interpretations missing from the agent’s work.
sents.zh: 这些材料不能用来补充智能体工作中缺失的科学分析或解释。

paragraphs.en: The first-pass grader evaluates each submission without access to previous assessments or other submissions. The targeted reviewer can examine the first-pass assessment and the supporting evidence. If further adjudication is needed, the adjudicator receives both earlier assessments and the remaining disputed issues. At no stage may previous grades or aggregate results substitute for scientific evidence from the submission.
paragraphs.zh: 初审评分员在无法访问先前评估或其他提交内容的情况下评估每份提交。 定向复审员可以查看初审评估及其支持证据。 如果需要进一步裁决，裁决者将收到此前的两项评估以及剩余的争议问题。 在任何阶段，先前的评分或汇总结果均不得替代来自提交内容的科学证据。

sents.en: The first-pass grader evaluates each submission without access to previous assessments or other submissions.
sents.zh: 初审评分员在无法访问先前评估或其他提交内容的情况下评估每份提交。

sents.en: The targeted reviewer can examine the first-pass assessment and the supporting evidence.
sents.zh: 定向复审员可以查看初审评估及其支持证据。

sents.en: If further adjudication is needed, the adjudicator receives both earlier assessments and the remaining disputed issues.
sents.zh: 如果需要进一步裁决，裁决者将收到此前的两项评估以及剩余的争议问题。

sents.en: At no stage may previous grades or aggregate results substitute for scientific evidence from the submission.
sents.zh: 在任何阶段，先前的评分或汇总结果均不得替代来自提交内容的科学证据。

paragraphs.en: The following shared instructions apply to all three grading stages.
paragraphs.zh: 以下共享指令适用于全部三个评分阶段。

paragraphs.en: Adjudication addresses only material disagreements remaining after targeted review, not a routine third full assessment. The adjudicator receives the task, complete rubric, relevant submitted evidence, first-pass assessment, review decisions, and precise disputed question. The shared grading instructions (Section H.2 ) apply throughout.
paragraphs.zh: 裁决仅针对在针对性复核后仍存在的实质性分歧，而非例行进行第三次完整评估。 裁决者将获得任务、完整的评分细则、相关已提交的证据、首次评估结果、复核决定以及确切存在争议的问题。 共享的评分说明（第 H.2 节）全程适用。

sents.en: Adjudication addresses only material disagreements remaining after targeted review, not a routine third full assessment.
sents.zh: 裁决仅针对在针对性复核后仍存在的实质性分歧，而非例行进行第三次完整评估。

sents.en: The adjudicator receives the task, complete rubric, relevant submitted evidence, first-pass assessment, review decisions, and precise disputed question.
sents.zh: 裁决者将获得任务、完整的评分细则、相关已提交的证据、首次评估结果、复核决定以及确切存在争议的问题。

sents.en: The shared grading instructions (Section H.2 ) apply throughout.
sents.zh: 共享的评分说明（第 H.2 节）全程适用。

paragraphs.en: Identify the dispute and affected requirements. Verify the attempt and evidence identity, the exact disputed criterion or closure condition, and its basis in the task. Retain the attempt’s validity classification unless validity itself is disputed. Identify unauthorized requirements or equivalence conflicts as rubric or fairness issues.
paragraphs.zh: 识别争议及受影响的需求。 核实尝试与证据的身份、确切的争议判据或收尾条件，及其在任务中的依据。 保留尝试的有效性分类，除非有效性本身存在争议。 将未经授权的需求或等价冲突识别为评分标准或公平性问题。

sents.en: Identify the dispute and affected requirements.
sents.zh: 识别争议及受影响的需求。

sents.en: Verify the attempt and evidence identity, the exact disputed criterion or closure condition, and its basis in the task.
sents.zh: 核实尝试与证据的身份、确切的争议判据或收尾条件，及其在任务中的依据。

sents.en: Retain the attempt’s validity classification unless validity itself is disputed.
sents.zh: 保留尝试的有效性分类，除非有效性本身存在争议。

sents.en: Identify unauthorized requirements or equivalence conflicts as rubric or fairness issues.
sents.zh: 将未经授权的需求或等价冲突识别为评分标准或公平性问题。

paragraphs.en: Examine the relevant evidence. Inspect the affected submitted figures, artifacts, and permissible reference material. Apply the shared attribution, equivalence, comparison, and high-result verification rules. Complete any missing mandatory check without rerunning calculations, repairing the submission, or supplying missing agent reasoning.
paragraphs.zh: 审查相关证据。 检查受影响的已提交图形、工件以及允许的参考资料。 应用共享的归因、等价、比较以及高结果验证规则。 补全任何缺失的强制性检查，但不得重新运行计算、修复提交内容，或补充缺失的智能体推理。

sents.en: Examine the relevant evidence.
sents.zh: 审查相关证据。

sents.en: Inspect the affected submitted figures, artifacts, and permissible reference material.
sents.zh: 检查受影响的已提交图形、工件以及允许的参考资料。

sents.en: Apply the shared attribution, equivalence, comparison, and high-result verification rules.
sents.zh: 应用共享的归因、等价、比较以及高结果验证规则。

sents.en: Complete any missing mandatory check without rerunning calculations, repairing the submission, or supplying missing agent reasoning.
sents.zh: 补全任何缺失的强制性检查，但不得重新运行计算、修复提交内容，或补充缺失的智能体推理。

paragraphs.en: Resolve the affected decisions. Apply the shared atomic, applicability, necessary-dependency, and RC rules only to decisions affected by the dispute. Preserve unrelated valid work and uncontested decisions. If an acceptable equivalent cannot be distinguished from a substantive error, retain the uncertainty rather than inventing a definite judgment.
paragraphs.zh: 解决受影响的决策。 仅将共享的原子性、适用性、必要依赖与 RC 规则应用于受争议影响的决策。 保留无关的有效工作与无争议的决策。 如果无法将可接受的等价情形与实质性错误区分开来，则保留这种不确定性，而不是虚构一个确定的判断。

sents.en: Resolve the affected decisions.
sents.zh: 解决受影响的决策。

sents.en: Apply the shared atomic, applicability, necessary-dependency, and RC rules only to decisions affected by the dispute.
sents.zh: 仅将共享的原子性、适用性、必要依赖与 RC 规则应用于受争议影响的决策。

sents.en: Preserve unrelated valid work and uncontested decisions.
sents.zh: 保留无关的有效工作与无争议的决策。

sents.en: If an acceptable equivalent cannot be distinguished from a substantive error, retain the uncertainty rather than inventing a definite judgment.
sents.zh: 如果无法将可接受的等价情形与实质性错误区分开来，则保留这种不确定性，而不是虚构一个确定的判断。

paragraphs.en: Record the decision and rationale. State the dispute, whether it is resolved, submitted and reference evidence examined, applicable rule, scientific reasoning, changes from review, and resulting score or RC where determined. Explain any effect on fairness, attempt validity, or a justified request for a new execution.
paragraphs.zh: 记录该决定及其理由。 说明争议内容、是否已解决、已提交并查阅的参考证据、适用的规则、科学推理、与评审的不同之处，以及在已确定的情况下得出的分数或 RC。 说明对公平性、尝试有效性或新执行请求（如有正当理由）的任何影响。

sents.en: Record the decision and rationale.
sents.zh: 记录该决定及其理由。

sents.en: State the dispute, whether it is resolved, submitted and reference evidence examined, applicable rule, scientific reasoning, changes from review, and resulting score or RC where determined.
sents.zh: 说明争议内容、是否已解决、已提交并查阅的参考证据、适用的规则、科学推理、与评审的不同之处，以及在已确定的情况下得出的分数或 RC。

sents.en: Explain any effect on fairness, attempt validity, or a justified request for a new execution.
sents.zh: 说明对公平性、尝试有效性或新执行请求（如有正当理由）的任何影响。

paragraphs.en: The targeted reviewer integrates the adjudication with the first-pass and review assessments. Preserve the initial assessment and record changes explicitly; do not average judgments. Prior assessments identify the dispute, not the scientific answer. Other submissions and expected score distributions do not determine the decision.
paragraphs.zh: 指定的复核智能体将裁决与首轮评估及复核评估进行整合。 保留初始评估并明确记录变更；不得对判断取平均值。 先前的评估用于识别争议，而非给出科学答案。 其他提交内容与预期分数分布不能决定该决定。

sents.en: The targeted reviewer integrates the adjudication with the first-pass and review assessments.
sents.zh: 指定的复核智能体将裁决与首轮评估及复核评估进行整合。

sents.en: Preserve the initial assessment and record changes explicitly; do not average judgments.
sents.zh: 保留初始评估并明确记录变更；不得对判断取平均值。

sents.en: Prior assessments identify the dispute, not the scientific answer.
sents.zh: 先前的评估用于识别争议，而非给出科学答案。

sents.en: Other submissions and expected score distributions do not determine the decision.
sents.zh: 其他提交内容与预期分数分布不能决定该决定。

paragraphs.en: The first-pass grader produces a structured assessment recording the validity of the run, decisions on the twenty atomic criteria, checks of key scientific results, and Research Closure with its supporting rationale. The assessment also records relevant evidence, reasons for failed or unresolved decisions, and any issues requiring further review.
paragraphs.zh: 首轮评分器生成一份结构化评估，记录运行的有效性、对二十条原子性准则的判定、关键科学结果的检查，以及研究收尾及其支持理由。 该评估还会记录相关证据、判定失败或未解决的原因，以及任何需要进一步审查的问题。

sents.en: The first-pass grader produces a structured assessment recording the validity of the run, decisions on the twenty atomic criteria, checks of key scientific results, and Research Closure with its supporting rationale.
sents.zh: 首轮评分器生成一份结构化评估，记录运行的有效性、对二十条原子性准则的判定、关键科学结果的检查，以及研究收尾及其支持理由。

sents.en: The assessment also records relevant evidence, reasons for failed or unresolved decisions, and any issues requiring further review.
sents.zh: 该评估还会记录相关证据、判定失败或未解决的原因，以及任何需要进一步审查的问题。

paragraphs.en: The Atomic Score is calculated from the accepted criterion-level decisions using the prescribed half-point and N/A rules. Runs with no assessable scientific work receive zero credit. Targeted review and, when necessary, adjudication document any changes to the initial assessment and the evidence supporting those changes.
paragraphs.zh: 原子分数（Atomic Score）根据已采纳的准则级判定，使用规定的半分与 N/A 规则计算得出。 没有可评估科学工作的运行将获得零分。 定向审查以及必要时进行的裁决会记录对初始评估的任何更改及支持这些更改的证据。

sents.en: Runs with no assessable scientific work receive zero credit.
